description: S59 T6 (EV7) at the DOOR: a reference is a POINTER, and the vocabulary a credential arrives under is refused on every method of this plane — write OR read — with the transport's bad-params code and the key named. This is the shape of the leak the whole plane exists to close: a client that can post a secret can also log it, proxy it and replay it. The sanctioned way in is the daemon's environment variable, a key file, or the daemon's own credential store. The refusal is a transport-level condition, so it keeps JSON-RPC's own code and carries no `data` (conformance/README): the shape of params is a protocol fact, not an Aeon refusal with a kind a client branches on.

error.message: invalid params: secretref.create params carry "token" — a secret reference is a name and a pointer; this plane has no field for a value, in this or any other key — the value lives in the source the reference names (S59 EV7)
